title: Wallace State Selects Lobaki to Develop Industry-First Diesel Exhaust After Treatment VR Training | User | dailytimesleader.com
text:
After evaluating existing VR solutions, Wallace partners with Lobaki for superior technical content and training quality JACKSON, MS - Lobaki , a leader in immersive technology solutions, today announced the successful completion of five specialized virtual reality training experiences for Wallace focused on diesel exhaust after treatment systems. This $112,000 project represents the first comprehensive VR training solution of its kind in the industry.
After previously investing in virtual reality training with another provider, Wallace made the strategic decision to partner with Lobaki based on the company's demonstrated ability to deliver technically precise, high-quality VR content specifically tailored to complex industrial applications.
"We're proud that Wallace recognized the superior quality and technical accuracy Lobaki brings to specialized VR training development," said Kevin Loud, CEO of Lobaki. "Our team's expertise in creating interactive simulations for complex mechanical systems like diesel exhaust after treatment sets a new standard in the industry."
These five new VR experiences give Wallace exclusive access to training solutions not available elsewhere in the industry. By selecting Lobaki's premium content development services, Wallace has secured a competitive advantage in technician training for one of the most challenging aspects of modern diesel engine technology.
"After reviewing our previous VR implementation, we determined that Lobaki's attention to technical detail and ability to translate complex systems into effective training experiences best met our standards for quality," said spokesperson for Wallace. "The difference in the final product is remarkable, providing our technicians with the most effective training possible."
For more information about Lobaki's virtual reality training solutions, visit lobaki.com .
About Lobaki
Lobaki is a leading developer of virtual and augmented reality solutions for education, training, and enterprise applications. The company specializes in creating immersive experiences that transform how people learn complex technical subjects through interactive, engaging virtual environments.
